title: AccountPlanObjMeasCalcCond - Tooling API
description: Represents a field and value combination for filtering records to include in the calculation of a sales account plan objective measure’s current value. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

AccountPlanObjMeasCalcDefId.description: The account plan objective measure calculation definition where this criteria is used. This field is a relationship field.

FieldName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
FieldName.description: A field on the calculation definition’s TargetObject that you want to filter by. Fields on the Campaign, Case, Contact, or Opportunity objects are supported.

Operation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Operation.description: The logical operator for matching records with the specified field value. Possible values are: Contains—contains Equals—equals GreaterOrEqual—greater or equal GreaterThan—greater than LessOrEqual—less or equal LessThan—less than NotContain—does not contain NotEqual—not equal to StartsWith

Value.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Value.description: The value to match for the specified field.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="AccountPlanObjMeasCalcCond">
  <xsd:sequence>
    <xsd:element name="fieldName" type="xsd:string"/>
    <xsd:element name="operation" type="xsd:string"/>
    <xsd:element name="value" type="xsd:string"/>
  </xsd:sequence>
</xsd:complexType>
```
